campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Inner cover present or absent, declared per experiment
campi_del_mandato.instrument: AER PLUS and RAD7; air flow imposed and measured, ACH computed as flow over volume
campi_del_mandato.licence: CC BY 4.0 (verified on the PDF, p.81)
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: The absolute baseline concentrations of the 2022 campaign are not tabulated: only the relative reductions. An absolute comparison with these data alone is not possible.
campi_del_mandato.sampling_frequency: Continuous to a new equilibrium per experiment
campi_del_mandato.site: Same scale model room, twelve ventilation experiments

soil_properties.motivo: no soil is involved: the radon source is the tuff wall material of the chamber, characterised in gallese2020_materiali.csv

campi_del_mandato.split: MIXED, and this is the project's first calibration assignment. Experiment 5 alone was used to estimate the background ACH of the chamber (leakage), n0 = 0.0389 per hour: it is CALIBRATION and must never be quoted as validation. Experiments 1-4 are then pure predictions and are validation. Experiments 6-12 are validation too, and the model FAILS them (z from 11.1 to 24.9): recorded as a falsification, not removed.
campi_del_mandato.units: Air flow L/min; ACH 1/h (positive injection, negative extraction); RIR percent

note: Assigned 2026-08-06, when the estimate was made. Before that date the project had no dataset in calibration. The reason is in docs/validazione-indoor-gallese.md.
